why: The hub of the festival guides lived at /festivals/ while the archive of the old festival site kept /; when the app took the whole host, the hub moved to the root. Its old address is in the sitemap index Google has and in eight indexing requests.
The hub's Markdown twin, which llms.txt named, moved with the hub.
The archive's own sitemap, which Search Console has; the app's index lists every page the archive's did.
The archive's paging of its listing (/node?page=N), which was not imported: the listing it paged is /concert/.
The paging of the archive's front page (/mainpage?page=N), which was not imported: that front page is /archive/ now.
The paging of the Sensation 2015 fan site's listing, which was not imported: its front page is /sensation2015/.
